Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent animated smoke flipbook texture atlas for a premium illustrated dark fantasy card combat game.
Primary request: a polished hand-painted animated dispersing smoke effect in EXACTLY four columns and two rows, eight equal square cells in landscape canvas 2048x1024, frames ordered left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each 512x512 cell shows the SAME centered smoke plume evolving over time. Frame 1 compact tightly furled dark violet-grey smoke knot, frame 2 expanding dense curling body, frame 3 dramatic full voluminous smoky bloom with scalloped curling lobes, frame 4 maximum spread with layered torn wisps, frame 5 tearing into separated cloudy ribbons and holes, frame 6 thinning curling fragments, frame 7 just a few fine dissipating wisps, frame 8 very faint residual smoke. Cohesive motion, consistent central anchor, same scale across every frame. Smoke has rich absorptive blue-charcoal shaded interiors, muted desaturated lilac rim lighting and bone grey highlights, painterly realistic fine turbulent details. Not fire, not neon, not opaque white cartoon clouds. Entirely transparent background with true alpha including translucent tips. All visible pixels strictly inside each cell with at least 50px completely transparent padding at boundaries. NO text labels, numbers, checkerboard, backdrop, grid lines, borders, rings, characters, skulls or objects. Production game VFX with excellent readability against a dark blue tavern table.
